title: fix(console, data-objectstack): the report drill's definition read names the report's package as the reader, and the chart colour probe's non-2xx guard is pinned (ADR-0150 D3)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XGTThyGEDtuYZPLNEPFrFRn)_

Fixes #32760

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:报表点击下钻时,如果服务端答复里没有现成的下钻过滤条件,控制台会再读一次数据集定义来拼过滤条件;这次读取现在带上报表所属包作为读者包(`?callerPackage=`),和报表自己的查询解析到同一个数据集。为此 `MetadataClient.get` 新增一个可选的 `callerPackage` 参数。另给图表颜色探测的「非 2xx 不解析」守卫补了一个能区分它的测试。
- 为什么改:卡 #32760 的三项复核遗留。第 1 项(32077 changeset 的 BREAKING 句)已随 18.4.0 一起发布,无文件可改,按卡的说明撤销。第 3 项实测发现这条「旧服务端」分支在当前服务端上也会走到:按 `type: 'date'` 且没有 `dateGranularity` 的维度分组的报表,服务端只给 `object` 不给下钻元数据,点击就落到这里,原来按裸名读取,包里的报表可能读到别的包的同名数据集,或两包同名时 `409`。
- 风险与回滚:风险低。只放宽(新增可选参数,不传时请求字节不变);无元数据、存储或 spec 变化。读取被拒时不下钻、不退回裸名重试。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ReportView.tsx` 的 `handleDatasetDrill`(回退分支带读者包);`ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/metadata-client.ts` 的 `MetadataGetOptions.callerPackage` 与 `readItemResponse`;`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ReportView.drillCallerPackage-32760.test.tsx`(用真实报表渲染器点击行)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/ReportView.drillCallerPackage-32760.test.tsx packages/data-objectstack/src/metadata-client.callerPackage-32760.test.ts`,预期 7 个全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The card's three items, each re-measured on `origin/main` (`71ade1ae`).

- **Item 1 dropped (as the card says to when a release cuts between).** `.changeset/32077-dataset-query-package.md` is not on `origin/main`: it shipped in 18.4.0 (PR #29963) together with #32629's changeset, and both are in the 18.4.0 sections of `plugin-charts`, `plugin-report`, `plugin-dashboard` and `data-objectstack` `CHANGELOG.md`. #32629's own 18.4.0 entry already states what happens to the 32077 BREAKING note (the dependency case is served again; `outside-closure` is the residual break, with its fix). No changeset is edited here.
- **Item 2, the colour probe's non-2xx guard is pinned.** `ObjectChart.optionColors.test.tsx` gains a row in the ADR-0150 D3 describe: a `409` whose body also carries a definition naming `task` (beside the ADR-0112 error). Without the guard the probe parses that body, reads `meta/object/task` and relabels `todo` as `To do` from a dataset the server refused to resolve. With it: one request (the refused definition read), raw labels, no colours. The existing `409` row stays as it is; it cannot tell the guard apart because its envelope names no object (#32629's A10).
- **Item 3, the ReportView drill fallback sends the reader's package.** Measured: the branch is not old-server-only, so it is not deleted.
  - `queryDataset` (`service-analytics`) sets `object` on every dataset answer. It sends `dimensionFields` / `drillRawRows` only for dimensions with a `field` and a type other than `date`, and `drillRanges` only for a date dimension with a `dateGranularity`. `DatasetDimensionSchema` makes `dateGranularity` optional, so a report grouped by a `type: 'date'` dimension with no granularity gets `object` and `drillScopes` but no exact filter. The renderer then emits the drill with no `objectFilter` (`DatasetReportTable`'s `drill`), and `handleDatasetDrill` takes the fallback, which read `metadataClient.get('dataset', NAME)` bare.
  - The fallback now reads it as the report's reader: `{ callerPackage: servedPackageId(editSchema || reportData) }`, the same served package the renderer's `ReportPackageContext` gives every selection (the renderer receives `previewReport`, the same `editSchema || reportData`). A report authored in the environment sends none. A refusal is caught as before (`ReportView: drill failed`), so no drawer opens and nothing is retried bare.
  - `MetadataClient.get` had no caller arm: its `packageId` is the exact qualifier `?package=` (D5), which refuses a dataset only a dependency holds. `MetadataGetOptions` gains an optional `callerPackage`, sent as `?callerPackage=` (the `/meta` door's D3 arm, `META_ITEM_CALLER_PACKAGE_PARAM` in `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`), omitted when absent or empty. Using the client keeps the console's one authenticated meta transport and its `?preview=draft` overlay, which a hand-rolled `fetch` would lose. The door refuses `callerPackage` beside `package` (`400`) and on any type but `dataset`; the client sends what it is given and does not pick between them.
  - The comment above `handleDatasetDrill` now says when the fallback runs and how it reads.
- Changeset `.changeset/32760-report-drill-caller-package.md`: `@object-ui/data-objectstack`, `@object-ui/app-shell` (private) and `@object-ui/console` (ships app-shell), patch. `plugin-charts` changes a test file only, which its `files[]` (`dist`) does not ship.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/plugin-charts/src/ObjectChart.optionColors.test.tsx`: "a refusal whose body names the object is still a refusal: no object read, theme palette kept".
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ReportView.drillCallerPackage-32760.test.tsx` (new). It renders the real `ReportView` with the real report renderer, answers the current server's shape for a date dimension with no granularity, and clicks the `dataset-drill-row`, so the fallback is reached through the input pipeline a user drives:
  - `READS_AS_THE_REPORTS_READER`: one definition read, `('dataset', 'task_metrics', { callerPackage: 'com.acme.app' })`, and the drawer opens on `task` with `{ due_date: '2026-03-01' }`.
  - `ENVIRONMENT_REPORT_READS_BARE`: a report with no `_packageId` reads with `{}`.
  - `REFUSAL_IS_NO_DRILL`: a rejected read is logged once, never retried, no drawer.
  - `FAST_PATH_CONTROL`: an answer with `dimensionFields` / `drillRawRows` drills with no definition read.
- `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/metadata-client.callerPackage-32760.test.ts` (new): `?callerPackage=` sent and never as `?package=`; encoded and beside `?preview=draft`; CONTROL, omitted or empty sends no parameter.
- Ablations (one-off, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restore proven `blob == HEAD` and `git diff HEAD` empty; `@object-ui/*` resolves to `src` through the vitest aliases, so no rebuild):

| leg | mutation | pinning file(s) | result |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| B1 | probe guard `if (!defRes.ok)` made never-true | `ObjectChart.optionColors.test.tsx` | 1 failed / 11 (the new row: `expected 'To do' to be 'todo'`); the old `409` row stays green |
| B2 | ReportView fallback passes `{}` whatever the package | the two new files | 2 failed / 7 (`READS_AS_THE_REPORTS_READER`, `REFUSAL_IS_NO_DRILL`) |
| B3 | client never pushes `callerPackage=` | the two new files | 2 failed / 7 (the two client rows that send one) |

## Acceptance notes

- **Item 3 route.** The order's PM hypothesis preferred deletion if no supported server reaches the branch. The measurement above shows the current server reaches it, so the ruling's other arm applies. Deleting it would leave a date-grouped report with no drill at all (the renderer emits no `objectFilter` for it).
- **The claim was amended for this route** (comment 6880606745): `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, the file surface plus `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/metadata-client.ts` and its test. `Metadata-protocol: none`: no metadata shape, schema, stored row or authorable key changes.
- **Seen, not filed (read-only inference).** On that fallback, a `type: 'date'` dimension with no granularity filters its field by the clicked group value as the answer shows it (`filter[due_date] = '2026-03-01'` here). Whether the server's label pass rewrites such a value before the client sees it was not measured; the drill result for those reports is therefore not claimed correct beyond the dataset it reads. The fallback still ignores the `object` the current server sends and takes the definition's.
- `ObjectChart.tsx` is not edited; the guard was only ablated.

## Verification

All readings on head `c72c8a04` unless noted (base `origin/main` `71ade1ae`). Every number is from a shared box under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`.

- build: `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' --filter '@object-ui/plugin-charts^...' build` (plus the `@objectstack` spec, formula, client, lint and sdui-parser closures), lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- type-check: `@object-ui/data-objectstack`, `@object-ui/app-shell` (`tsc --noEmit` and `tsconfig.test.json`), `@object-ui/plugin-charts` (both): each `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- suites: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/data-objectstack/ packages/plugin-charts/ packages/app-shell/src/views/ReportView`: 229 files passed, 2755 tests passed, 9 skipped, `VERDICT command-exit 0` (head `4afe687a`; the last commit only adds a module-top import to the new ReportView test, which was re-run alone on `c72c8a04`: 4/4).
- derived gates: `dispatch-gates --ran` reads 37 derived, 37 run, each `exit 0`, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. The first pass (head `4afe687a`) had one red, `check:test-source-alias` on the new ReportView test (a dynamic `import('@objectstack/lint')` reached through `ReportConfigPanel`); fixed by the module-top import, then all 37 re-run on `c72c8a04`.
- `check:type-check-debt`: 0 ledger entries re-measured for this diff (none of the touched packages is in the ledger).
